root_cause.text: `cdc_ncm_rx_verify_ndp32()` in the USB CDC-NCM driver validated the NDP32/DPE array size against `skb_in->len` without including `ndpoffset`, so an NDP32 placed near the end of the NTB could pass the check and trigger out-of-bounds reads.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes `if ((sizeof(struct usb_cdc_ncm_ndp32) + ret * sizeof(struct usb_cdc_ncm_dpe32)) > skb_in->len)` to compute `ndp_len = struct_size_t(struct usb_cdc_ncm_ndp32, dpe32, ret);` and check `if (ndpoffset + ndp_len > skb_in->len)`, and the commit message explicitly says the DPE array size was validated “without accounting for ndpoffset, allowing out-of-bounds reads when the NDP32 is placed near the end of the NTB.”

intent_record.intent_summary: Introduce a local NDP length variable in the NDP32 verification path for subsequent use.
intent_record.what: A new local variable `size_t ndp_len;` was added in `cdc_ncm_rx_verify_ndp32()` alongside the existing `ndp32` pointer and `ret` variable declarations.
intent_record.how: This change does not alter runtime behavior by itself; it only prepares the function to store or compute the NDP length later in the function body.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix NDP32 length validation to correctly account for the offset and computed structure size when checking skb bounds.
intent_record.what: The length check in cdc_ncm_rx_verify_ndp32() was changed from a manual calculation using sizeof(struct usb_cdc_ncm_ndp32) plus ret times sizeof(struct usb_cdc_ncm_dpe32) to computing ndp_len with struct_size_t(struct usb_cdc_ncm_ndp32, dpe32, ret), and the bounds check now compares ndpoffset + ndp_len against skb_in->len instead of comparing only the computed NDP size.
intent_record.how: At runtime, the function now validates the full NDP region starting at ndpoffset rather than just the raw structure size, which makes the packet bounds check more accurate and prevents out-of-bounds access when parsing NDP entries.

grouping_result.intent: Introduce a local NDP length variable in the NDP32 verification path for subsequent use.
Fix NDP32 length validation to correctly account for the offset and computed structure size when checking skb bounds.

relevance_review.reason: The change touches the NDP32 verification path and introduces a local NDP length variable for validation logic, which is directly related to the root cause of incorrect NDP32/DPE size checking in cdc_ncm_rx_verify_ndp32().
The change directly matches the root cause: it fixes NDP32/DPE bounds validation by accounting for the NDP offset and structure size, preventing the out-of-bounds read condition.

candidates.rationale: This size check validates the NDP32/DPE area only against skb_in->len and omits ndpoffset, allowing an NDP32 near the end of the NTB to pass bounds checking even when the structure extends past the buffer.

This is the initial NDP32 bounds check in the vulnerable path; if the subsequent length validation fails to account for ndpoffset, the parser can still proceed with an NDP32 positioned near the buffer end and later read out of bounds.

vuln_statements.explanation: This is the NDP32/DPE size validation that was rooted in the bug: it checked the structure size against the buffer without incorporating ndpoffset, allowing an NDP32 placed near the end of the NTB to pass and later cause out-of-bounds reads.
